body:
Confirmed live: outbound TCP connection from the Stalwart box (45.79.143.216) to Gmail's SMTP servers on port 25 times out -- Linode's standard anti-abuse block on new accounts/instances, unrelated to our own DKIM/SPF/DMARC config (all independently verified correct). Explains the exact reported symptom: inbound works (unblocked), outbound doesn't. Two real fixes via the Linode API: RDNS for 45.79.143.216 set to mail.carepyre.org (was the generic Linode default -- Gmail/Outlook check this strictly too), and a real support ticket (#27380609) filed requesting the port-25 block be lifted for this Linode. Documented in docs/STALWART_RUNBOOK.md. CarePyre commit e7c236d.

⚓ ☃
title: Found and fixed real cause of Gmail send failures: Linode outbound port 25 block
